subject: Tasks disappearing from shared project
body:
Hi,

For the past three days, tasks in our "Client Onboarding" project have been disappearing without anyone deleting them. It's happened at least eight times that we know of. The tasks aren't in the trash, and the activity log doesn't show a delete event. They're just gone. In two cases the task reappeared a few hours later with its comments missing, which is almost worse because now we don't trust what we're seeing.

We have about 15 people working in that project at any time, mostly on the web app, a couple on mobile. Nobody has changed permissions or automations recently. The only change I can think of is that we moved the project into a new folder last Monday.

This project holds our onboarding checklists for new clients, so missing tasks mean missed steps with real customers. Can you please look at what's happening on your side? I can give you task names that went missing if that helps.

Thanks,
Ayesha Karim
Client Services Manager
Workspace: brightwater-hr.ourapp.com
changes not saving. i edit a task description, click away, come back and it's the old version

subject: Data out of sync between users
body: My colleague and I are looking at the same board at the same time and seeing different things: she sees 42 tasks in the "In Review" column, I see 38. Refreshing doesn't fix it. Logging out and in made mine match hers for about 10 minutes, then they drifted apart again. Which one is correct? We're making decisions based on this board.

subject: Lost comments
body: All comments older than about two weeks have vanished from every task in our workspace. The tasks are fine, just no comment history before the 3rd. That's months of client feedback and approvals we need for our records. Workspace ID ws_30917. Please tell me they can be restored.
Something weird: a task I completed yesterday is showing as incomplete again today, and my checkmark on the subtasks is gone too. It's happened to 3 tasks now.

subject: Offline edits overwritten
body: I worked on my laptop on a flight (offline mode), made a bunch of changes to our launch plan, and when I landed and reconnected, all my edits were overwritten by the server version. The app didn't warn me about any conflict. I lost about 3 hours of work. Is there any way to recover what I wrote? And how do I stop this happening next time?

subject: Duplicate tasks appearing
body: Every time someone edits a task from the mobile app, a duplicate of that task appears on the web version. So now we have two copies of many tasks and we don't know which one is the real one. It started last week. We're a team of 8 and our board is getting really messy. Workspace: oakhurst-builders.ourapp.com
The custom field values on about half our tasks were wiped overnight. All the "Budget" and "Client" fields are empty. Other fields fine. This is our whole reporting setup. Org ID 64410.

subject: Attachments missing
body: Files attached to tasks before last month now show a broken file icon and "File not found" when clicked. Newer files open fine. We have contracts and signed documents in there that we can't lose.

subject: Project reverted to old version
body:
Hello,

This morning our entire "Product Roadmap" project looks like it did about three weeks ago. Tasks we completed are back in progress, tasks we added in the last three weeks are gone, and due dates we changed are back to the old dates. It's as if someone restored a backup from mid-month, but nobody on our side did anything like that, and our admin says there's no restore option he could have clicked by accident.

The other projects in the workspace look normal as far as we can tell. We have 22 people who use that roadmap every day and a leadership review on Thursday that's based on it.

Can you check whether something happened on your end, and whether the last three weeks of changes can be recovered? I'm really worried we've lost them.

Org ID 18803.

Thanks,
Ben Achterberg
Head of Product
Task I moved to another project shows up in BOTH projects now. Editing one edits the other. Is it duplicated or linked?

subject: Time entries missing
body: About 40 hours of logged time from last week have disappeared from our time reports. The team logged the hours (they have screenshots), but the entries aren't in the task timers or in the reports anymore. We use these hours to invoice clients, so this is a big deal for us.

subject: Sync issue + export
body: Two things: our shared calendar view shows different due dates than the task detail view for the same task (e.g. calendar says Tuesday, task says Thursday). Not sure which is right. Also, separately, what's the best way to export all our tasks to Excel? We need a backup of everything.
Every time I reorder the tasks in a list, the order resets for everyone else after a refresh. My order sticks for me but nobody else sees it. We use manual order for priorities so this is a problem.

subject: Deleted user's data
body: When we removed a member last week, all the tasks he created disappeared along with him, not just his account. That's about 200 tasks across our projects. We thought removing a member kept their content. Can the tasks be recovered? Workspace ID W-23308.

subject: Slack integration stopped posting
body: Our Slack integration stopped posting task updates to our channels about 4 days ago. The integration page says "Connected" and the channels are still listed. I've tried disconnecting and reconnecting. Nothing shows in Slack. We rely on this for our daily stand-ups.
salesforce sync not updating opportunity status since monday. field mapping unchanged. please check

subject: Google Drive attachments
body: When we attach files from Google Drive, they show up as a link that says "You need access" even for people in our Google Workspace who have access to the file. Attaching from Dropbox works fine. It used to work with Drive until about 2 weeks ago.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Our Zap that triggers on "New task in project" hasn't fired since Friday. Zapier's task history shows no triggers at all, so it seems like your side isn't sending anything. The Zap is on and the connection test in Zapier succeeds. We use it to create tickets in our helpdesk automatically, so tickets are piling up unassigned.

subject: Microsoft Teams integration
body:
Hi,

We installed your Microsoft Teams app a month ago and it worked well at first: task notifications appeared in our Teams channels and people could create tasks from messages. Since last week, the "Create task" message action shows an error ("We couldn't reach the service, please try again later"), and notifications arrive hours late or not at all.

We're on Microsoft 365 Business Premium. Our IT admin reinstalled the app and re-granted permissions, with no change. Other third-party apps in Teams work normally. We have about 60 people who use the Teams integration daily, and they're starting to go back to email, which is what we were trying to avoid.

Could you please look at the logs for our tenant? I can give you our tenant ID if that helps.

Our workspace is ridgeline-energy.ourapp.com.

Thanks,
Chris Mbeki
IT Systems Lead
GitHub integration: PR links aren't showing on tasks anymore. We mention the task ID in the PR title like the docs say. Worked until last week.

subject: Jira sync creating duplicates
body: Our two-way Jira sync is creating a duplicate issue in Jira every time a task is updated here. So far about 300 duplicate issues in our Jira project. We've paused the sync. Can you tell us why and how to clean up? The sync ID in our settings is SYNC-JIRA-7720.

subject: Outlook calendar sync one-way only
body: Tasks with due dates show up in my Outlook calendar, but when I move them in Outlook, the due date here doesn't change. I thought the sync was two-way? It says two-way in the integration settings.
HubSpot integration keeps asking me to re-authenticate every day. I click Reconnect, authorise, and it works until the next morning. Very tedious.

subject: Slack integration + a question about pricing
body: Hi, our Slack notifications are coming through without task names, just "A task was updated". It used to include the task title and who changed it. Could you look into that? Also, is the Slack integration included on the Starter plan? We're thinking of downgrading.

subject: Can't connect QuickBooks
body: When I try to connect QuickBooks Online, the OAuth window opens, I log in and approve, and then it says "Connection failed: invalid_grant". I'm the QuickBooks admin. Tried 5 times over 2 days. We wanted to start syncing our time entries for invoicing this month.

subject: Integration disconnected itself
body: Our Google Calendar integration disconnected by itself sometime last night and every member now has to reconnect individually. About 50 people. Is there a way for an admin to reconnect it for everyone? And why did it disconnect in the first place?
Is the Dropbox integration still supported? It disappeared from our integrations page and our existing Dropbox links in tasks stopped opening.

subject: Slack: wrong channel
body: Since we reconnected Slack, all notifications from every project go to #general instead of the channels we mapped to each project. The mapping is still there in settings. We've had some client names leak into #general because of this, which isn't great.

subject: Zendesk integration fields
body: Hello, we use your Zendesk integration to create tasks from tickets. Since the update, the ticket priority and requester fields are not being copied to the task anymore, only the subject. We need priority to triage. Workspace ID ws_58127.

subject: API rate limits
body: What are the rate limits for the REST API on the Business plan? We're building a sync that will run every 5 minutes across about 2,000 tasks and want to make sure we stay under the limit. Is it per API key or per workspace?

POST /v2/tasks returns 400 with {"error": "invalid_field", "field": "custom_fields"} when I include a custom field. The field ID is copied straight from GET /v2/custom-fields. Request id req_c0ffee42. What's the correct format?

subject: Webhooks not being delivered
body: We registered a webhook for task.updated events three days ago. The webhook shows as "Active" in the developer settings, but our endpoint hasn't received a single event. We've confirmed our endpoint is publicly reachable and returns 200 to a test POST from Postman. Is there a way to see delivery attempts and errors on your side?

subject: OAuth app review
body:
Hi,

We're building a public integration that lets our customers connect their workspaces to our reporting product through OAuth. In the developer console, our app is listed as "In development", and only users in our own workspace can authorise it. Other workspaces get "This application is not available".

The docs mention an app review process before an OAuth app can be used by other organisations, but I couldn't find how to start it or how long it takes. We're aiming to launch with a pilot customer in about three weeks, so I'd like to understand the timeline and any requirements (security review, privacy policy, scopes justification, etc.) as early as possible.

Our developer account is under dev-team@ledgerloop.io and the app client ID is cli_8Hq2mX0pWd.

Thanks,
Sara Lindqvist
Engineering Manager, LedgerLoop
api token keeps expiring after 1 hour. docs say personal tokens don't expire. am i generating the wrong kind?

subject: Pagination returning duplicates
body: When paginating GET /v2/projects/{id}/tasks with cursor pagination, we get some tasks twice and miss others. It seems to happen when tasks are updated while we're paginating. Is there a stable sort order we should request? Example request ID: req_5b8e2a19.

subject: Webhook signature header missing
body: Webhook requests we receive don't include the X-Signature header described in your docs, so we can't verify them. We've logged the full headers and there's nothing signature-related. Is signing something we need to turn on?

subject: API: 403 on endpoints that worked yesterday
body: Our service account's API key gets 403 Forbidden on GET /v2/users since this morning. Yesterday it worked. Other endpoints still work with the same key. No permission changes on our side. This is breaking our HR onboarding automation. acct_hr0913
Is there a GraphQL API, or only REST? And is there an official Python SDK? Couldn't find one on your docs site.

subject: Bulk update endpoint
body: Is there an endpoint to update many tasks in one request? We need to change the status of about 5,000 tasks and doing it one call at a time hits the rate limit quickly. If not, what's the recommended approach?

subject: API returning 500 for one project
body: GET /v2/projects/prj_88213/tasks returns 500 Internal Server Error every time. Other projects work. The project opens fine in the web app. Request IDs: req_7a1f0c33, req_7a1f0c9e. Could you check the logs?

subject: Sandbox environment?
body: Do you provide a sandbox or test environment for API development? We don't want to test our integration against our production workspace where 300 people are working.
Our webhook endpoint was down for about 6 hours yesterday. Do you retry failed deliveries? And if so, for how long? We need to know if we missed events or if they'll come through.

subject: API docs incorrect
body: The docs for PATCH /v2/tasks/{id} say that "assignees" accepts an array of emails, but it only accepts user IDs. Passing emails returns 422. Could you fix the docs? Cost us a few hours this week. Also, is there a way to look up user IDs by email in one call?

subject: Scopes for read-only integration
body: We're building an internal dashboard that only reads tasks and projects. Which OAuth scopes do we need at minimum? We want to avoid requesting write access. Our security team is strict about least privilege.

subject: Rate limited + webhook question
body: Hi, we're hitting 429s way more than expected: about 30 requests per minute and we get limited. Docs say the limit is 100/min. Also, unrelated, can a single webhook subscription cover multiple projects or do we need one per project? Example 429 request: req_a9d0e711.
The "created_at" field in API responses is in local time without a timezone offset, but the docs say ISO 8601 UTC. Which is it? Our reports are off by hours.

subject: Personal access token for a bot
body: We want a bot account to make API calls, but personal access tokens are tied to a person and we don't want it to break when that person leaves. Is there a service account or workspace-level token option?

subject: Webhook events out of order
body:
Hello,

We consume your task.created and task.updated webhooks to keep a mirror of tasks in our data warehouse. We've noticed that events regularly arrive out of order: we'll get a task.updated for a task before the task.created, or two task.updated events where the older one arrives last and overwrites the newer state in our mirror.

We can handle this if each event includes a reliable sequence number or a precise updated_at timestamp, but the updated_at field seems to only have second precision, and we often see several updates within the same second.

Is there a recommended pattern for this? Is there a sequence or version field we're missing? We'd rather not poll the API after every event to get the latest state because of rate limits.

Example delivery IDs where this happened: evt_01JC7A1X4M and evt_01JC7A1X4P.

Thanks,
Daniel Ferreira
Data Engineering, Portside Logistics

how do i export everything? like all projects, all tasks, comments, attachments. need a full backup

subject: Migrating from Monday.com
body:
Hi team,

We're moving our 60-person agency from Monday.com and would like to bring over about 120 boards with their items, subitems, statuses, owners, due dates, and ideally the comment history (they call them updates). We've looked at your import options and see CSV and a direct Trello and Asana importer, but nothing for Monday.

What would you recommend? If CSV is the only route, is there a template that maps well to Monday's export format? We're especially worried about subitems becoming separate tasks and losing the parent link, and about people assignments not matching because our emails are slightly different between the two tools.

We'd like to switch over during a quiet week at the end of the month, so we have about three weeks to plan. If you offer migration help as a paid service, we'd be open to that too.

Thanks,
Laura Castellano
Operations Director, Brightline Creative

Export to Excel gives me a file where all the dates are text instead of dates, so I can't sort or filter by date in Excel. Is there an option for proper date cells?

body: We have an in-house task tracker that can export JSON. Do you have an import format for JSON, or should we convert to CSV? We have about 25,000 tasks with parent/child relationships, which I'm guessing CSV can't represent. Org ID 70991.

subject: Import mapped users wrong

exported our workspace but the zip file is only 2MB and we have gigabytes of attachments. are attachments not included??

subject: Importing from Jira
